title: Eco-evolutionary cycles in a matching type predator-prey interaction
summary: We study the population dynamics of a predator-prey system with two types in each species. Within a species, predator or prey, dynamics are described by a neutral competitive Lotka-Volterra model, i.e., birth, death and competition parameters are equal for both types. Additionally, we assume that the intra- and inter-type competition parameters are equal. The predator-prey interaction is defined by a matching-types model where predators of type $i$ exclusively interact with prey of type $i$.
